newsitem.title: USA: Signature Inns amends IPO filing.
newsitem.headline: Signature Inns amends IPO filing.

text.p: Signature Inns Inc said Monday it has amended its registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission and that it will now offer two million shares of the company's cumulative convertible preferred stock, Series A at $20 per share.

The company said it expects that the sale of the preferred stock to the public will commence in January 1997 and that it intends to use the proceeds of the offering to acquire full ownership of all of the operating Signature Inn hotels which are now owned by various partnerships in which the company is general partner.
In November, the Indiana hotel company postponed a public offering of 3.3 million shares.
